subject: Custom SLA addendum & order form language for Instamed enterprise MSA
messages:
From: Sara West <sara.west@instamed.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@instamed.com
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: custom SLA addendum + order form language for MSA/SOW

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Instamed's platform team was impressed with the latency profiles. Procurement asked me to pull together a single request so we can get redlines into our MSA and the order form before legal routing. High level asks:

- We need an addendum to the enterprise MSA that calls out a regional availability commitment of 99.95% (monthly) for the hosted inference endpoint used by our production tenant.
- P95 end-to-end request latency <= 350ms for text-generation (avg seq len 128), with a defined methodology for measurement and a 30-day rolling window for SLO calculations.
- A documented exception carveout for scheduled maintenance + two planned burst windows per month (not to exceed 4 hours total); we are ok with reasonable advance notice.
- Evidence required: sample telemetry export (token-level latency histogram), uptime runbook (how incidents are detected and notified), and the recommended rollback/fallback model variant you would use for degraded regions.

I've attached the current SOW draft (Instamed_SOW_Draft_v1.docx) and a short requirements matrix. Can you propose language we can include in the order form (availability exhibit + measurement clause) and confirm what evidence you can provide during procurement?

Timeline: procurement needs redlines by COB Oct 27 to hit our renewal window. If helpful we can schedule a 30-minute technical alignment next week.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara West
Director, Cloud Operations | Instamed Health
attachments: Instamed_SOW_Draft_v1.docx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara West <sara.west@instamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum + order form language for MSA/SOW

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping in Karthik (infrastructure/product) and Monica (enterprise contracts) so we can coordinate redlines and evidence. Summary of how we'll approach this and next steps: 

1) Draft addendum + order form language: we'll propose a short exhibit that attaches to the MSA and an order-form clause that specifies the measurement methodology (synthetic vs production telemetry), SLO window, and credit schedule. Expect a first draft by EOD Oct 24.

2) Latency measurement: Karthik will confirm the exact P95 measurement points and sampling approach. We propose measuring at the API gateway edge (production traffic) and providing a 30-day rolling P95 report with raw histograms for the month in CSV. If you need synthetic benchmarks, we can provide those as separate artifacts.

3) Exceptions & burst windows: We can include the two planned burst windows allowance you requested. For any additional availability deviation we will surface a remediation plan with timelines in the runbook.

4) Evidence bundle: we'll attach a proposed 'evidence pack' to the addendum: example telemetry export, runbook summary, and a remediation/oncall flow. Karthik has a template for the telemetry export.

Action items (for clarity):
- Naomi: deliver draft addendum + order-form clause (Oct 24) — redwood_proposed_addendum_v1.pdf will be attached.
- Karthik: provide telemetry evidence template and measurement note (Oct 22).
- Monica: prepare suggested contract language and credit table for procurement (Oct 24).
- Sara: confirm whether production telemetry is acceptable vs synthetic testing (reply), and share any mandatory wording your legal team requires.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Tue 10/24 10:00–10:30am PT if we need to walk through the technical bits?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Enterprise GTM | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_proposed_addendum_v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sara West <sara.west@instamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Oct 2028 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: custom SLA addendum + order form language for MSA/SOW

Sara / Naomi — quick technical note to make sure the draft aligns with operational reality. Key points I will include in the measurement appendix: 

- Measurement point: P95 computed from request accept time at the API gateway to final token flush (edge-to-edge). We'll include the definition and sample query for the metrics API.
- Sequence length assumption: we'll call out the default 128-token profile and include a table showing expected P50/P95/P99 for 64/128/256 token profiles (sample numbers).
- Fallbacks: for region-level degradations we recommend automatic routing to a compatible model variant with documented differences (quantized variant for cost/latency tradeoff). The addendum should say "automatic regional fallback may be used to preserve availability with documented behavioral differences" and link to the model-variant appendix.
- Evidence format: we will provide a zipped CSV of token-level latency histograms per 6-hour bucket for the requested 30-day window (example file: telemetry_evidence_template.csv). For security reasons the export will be scrubbed of PII and customer identifiers.

I'll attach the telemetry template and a short measurement note you can share with Instamed. If Instamed expects provider-side synthetic testing as proof-of-performance, call that out and we can schedule a bench run.

-Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
attachments: telemetry_evidence_template.csv

Hi Naomi / Karthik — this looks good, thanks. Production telemetry is preferable for measurement; synthetic is fine as a supplement for corner-case validation. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- We need the exact credit schedule spelled out (monthly credit % for 99.9x ranges). Can you provide a sample table in the addendum?
- DocuSign: procurement is ready to route once redlines land. I attached our requirements matrix and the DocuSign envelope (link below).
- DPA: our legal team wants the addendum to reference the DPA section and confirm logs retention for 12 months (we're not asking to store data ourselves, just to confirm the telemetry retention policy).

We can take the call Tue 10/24 10:00am PT. Sending procurement timeline: sign by Nov 3 is ideal.

Thanks,
Sara
